FACT TO ADD/CORRECT under 'Surviving Regeneration: checksum ignore and normalisation': .generator-ignore has no negation. Each line is a glob on the file path, so a line starting with "!" does not re-include a file. A file is excluded when any .generator-ignore from its folder up to the project root matches, and a child folder cannot override a parent rule. Narrow the broader pattern instead of negating it. | EVIDENCE: src/main/resources/agent-docs/components/generator-ignore.md:73 | judo-ng finding: A '!' prefix in .generator-ignore negates a pattern, so '!generated/important.txt' keeps the file.
